shared_elements: anthropomorphic face or facial features (eye/brow forms)
bold schematic relief modelling of human-like features
justification: Both surfaces appear to present a schematic anthropomorphic face — A a full frontal head with heavy brow, nose and mouth on a standing torso, B a large curvilinear eye-and-brow motif embedded in relief scrollwork — which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a complete free-standing figure with body, arms and nipples in massive rounded volumes, while B is a dense, flattened field of interlaced curvilinear low relief with no legible body or figure arrangement, so relationships, layout and carving conventions differ substantially.
